clientFindings.title: Older same-visit conversation read can overwrite confirmed reply
clientFindings.actual: Actual native TicketScreen: hold an older history retry, send/confirm a new reply, verify it becomes visible, then release older response. Reply disappears and stale Solved state returns, while synthetic DB retains the committed reply.
clientFindings.cause: Generation increments only on focus/route initialization, not each read or confirmed mutation; both loads share the same visit. Web Ticket uses the same read fence shape.
clientFindings.proposedBoundedFix: Add monotonically advancing per-read ownership and retire older reads when starting a refresh/readback or confirming a mutation. Keep route/account/unmount fences. Apply only the latest issued current-scope response.
clientFindings.regression: Actual component: delayed older history retry released after newer successful reply/readback must not hide the confirmed reply or restore old status.

clientFindings.title: Stale confirmation clears durable retry identity while retained draft remains
clientFindings.actual: Actual native TicketScreen: send, blur/refocus, release successful reply. Screen discards stale completion and preserves draft, but shared helper already removed its UUID. Pressing Send again inserts the identical body under a second UUID.
clientFindings.cause: Shared helper clears persisted request identity on backend confirmation before caller determines whether that confirmation belongs to the current draft/visit.
clientFindings.proposedBoundedFix: Separate confirmation from acknowledging/removing the retry identity. Clear the persisted key only when the owning current draft accepts the receipt and is cleared; preserve a stable receipt/key across stale/unmounted completion. Keep intentional later identical submissions possible after acknowledgement.
clientFindings.regression: Actual component blur/refocus and unmount/revisit confirmation cases must reuse the UUID when the original visible draft has not been acknowledged. Cover both reply and new-ticket helper.

clientFindings.title: Undispatched mutation can rebind after same-owner session ABA
clientFindings.actual: Hold actual helper digest, unmount actual TicketScreen, change synthetic bearer A1→B→A2, release digest. Installed Supabase SDK emits the original reply under Bearer session-A2 and its expected-user check still accepts owner A.
clientFindings.cause: Write dispatch has no captured session identity, pinned Authorization header or current undispatched-lifecycle predicate after awaited digest/storage phases. Navigation session boundary unmounts UI but cannot cancel the suspended helper.
clientFindings.proposedBoundedFix: Reuse existing exact-session scope and pinned-bearer pattern used by job saves. Check lifecycle/session immediately before constructing/dispatching a write after all awaited preparation; abort on scope invalidation, preserve stable retry identity, and do not treat aborted/timed-out transport as proof of rollback.
clientFindings.regression: Queued preparation plus A→B→A and same-owner new login must issue no stale write; token refresh within same stable session remains compatible.

clientProbeScope: Actual TicketScreen callbacks with controlled hook/focus/native hosts; actual shared helper and installed Supabase client; synthetic in-memory provider, AsyncStorage-shaped store, digest gate. No provider calls or actual native scheduling acceptance.
